camel_example: aliyun cs GET /addons --region cn-hangzhou --cluster_version '1.32.1-aliyun.1' --cluster_id c02b3e03be10643e8a644a843ffcb0000 --cluster_spec 'ack.pro.small' --profile Default --region_id 'cn-hangzhou' --cluster_type ManagedKubernetes --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Queries the list of available components based on specified parameters such as region, cluster type, cluster subtype (profile), and cluster version. You can also retrieve detailed component information, including whether a component is managed, the schema of supported custom parameters, and compatible operating system architectures
description_zh: 您可以调用ListAddons接口，根据指定地域、集群类型、集群子类型（profile）、集群版本等参数获取可用组件的列表，并查询组件的详细信息，包括组件托管与否、支持的自定义参数Schema、兼容的操作系统架构等
kebab_example: aliyun cs list-addons --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-type ManagedKubernetes --biz-profile Default --cluster-spec ack.pro.small --cluster-version 1.32.1-aliyun.1 --cluster-id c02b3e03be10643e8a644a843ffcb0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAddons

category.description_en:
The component categorization. Valid values:

core: core component.
network: network type component.
security: security component.
storage: storage component.
monitor: logging and monitoring component.
application: application component.

An empty value indicates that the component belongs to another category
category.description_zh:
组件分类。

core：核心组件。
network：网络类型组件。
security：安全组件。
storage：存储组件。
monitor：日志与监控组件。
application：应用组件。

返回内容为空表示组件类型为其他
